title: The $27,000 power user
blurb: One Claude user consumed ~$27K of compute in 23 days on a $200 plan — a 135× subsidy.
body:
One Claude user reportedly consumed ~$27,000 of compute in 23 days on a $200/month plan — a 135× subsidy.

Estimated usage

  • ~1.1B est. total tokens
  • ~$27K est. API cost
  • 9,221 sub-agent spawns
  • ~335K avg tokens / session

A vivid data point on the unit economics of "unlimited" agentic plans — and why per-seat pricing is under pressure as agents spawn agents.

SOURCE · viral usage screenshot (estimates based on session data).
